headline:
لعبة Ranger's Path
تصدر كاملة الثلاثاء
label: رسمي

angle.hook: a game where you work as a park ranger leaves its unfinished Early Access stage and reaches consoles on Tuesday, now with a second ranger in co-op
angle.why_now: the dated launch is Tuesday 17 Nov 2026, two days after the slot (announced on Steam 17 Sep, repeated 8 Oct, 21 Oct and 28 Oct with the Bigfoot teaser); no Arabic outlet has carried it (git grep and the digests); same kind as the Unicorn Academy and Spirit Crossing launch Reels built today
angle.what_it_means_here: players in the region on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S get a calm nature simulator they could not play before, and PC players get the finished game; 53 dirhams on the Steam store in the UAE today
angle.payoff: 2-player co-op: two rangers sharing a shift, closing on the two of them watching an elk

story_type_items.OUT NOW (release dated): platforms PC (full release), PS5, Xbox Series X|S (Steam announcement 21 Oct: 'On November 17, Ranger's Path will leave Early Access with its Full Release on PC and arrive on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S'); AED price: Steam store in the UAE 53 dirhams (appdetails cc=ae, read 15 Nov 04:40Z), console prices in the region not read, so not stated; what it is: a national-park ranger simulator (Steam short description)

sensitive: none: no weapons on screen (the tranquilizer gun of EA update 2 is not in any chosen shot), no injured animals (the carcass on the road at 30.5 to 31.3 s of the Multiplayer Trailer avoided), the axe and log-sawing shots avoided
decision_log: sources: two official Steam trailers fetched as the server fetches them (ffmpeg -ss 0 on the HLS, -c copy): 'Multiplayer Trailer' (8 Oct 2026, 1920x1080 60 fps 5.6 Mbps, 45.4 s) and 'Park Impressions Trailer' (Nov 2025, 1920x1080, 116.6 s). The 'Bigfoot Trailer' (28 Oct) was opened and rejected: burnt-in English subtitles on almost every frame and Bigfoot is never shown. Scene cuts measured on the seek timeline (ffmpeg -ss 0 scene>0.2); every start is cut+0.08 to 0.25 s, every end before the next cut; first, middle and last frame of every shot viewed as the 9:16 crop
0 to 3.5 headline: two rangers at sunset (MP 12.24, focus 0.70 on the right ranger: the two silhouettes cannot both fit 9:16), then the waterfall (PI 40.6): the park and its rangers, the game itself

line 1 «في Ranger's Path تحرس حديقة وطنية» over one ranger at work: walking into the forest (MP 27.28), by the tent (MP 28.94), at the picnic area (MP 15.01), at a crate (MP 16.69), the ranger truck on a trail (MP 21.13): every shot is the ranger's job

line 2 «اللعبة على PC منذ مارس بنسخة غير مكتملة» over the park from the Park Impressions trailer (giant sequoia PI 48.5, hikers on a path PI 17.45): illustration of the Early Access game (state 1 of the comparison)

hard cut to state 2. line 3 «النسخة الكاملة تصدر يوم الثلاثاء 17 نوفمبر» over the mountain view from the park (PI 61.0; v1's visitor lodge at PI 8.95 replaced: the server prerender read its 'Visitor Center' sign cut by the 9:16 edge) and the covered bridge (PI 14.6); line 4 «وتصل أيضًا إلى PS5 و Xbox Series X|S» over the forest road (PI 44.5) and the meadow and rocks (PI 56.15): illustration, the platforms are a fact of the announcement, not of the footage

line 5 «الإصدار الكامل يضيف لعبًا تعاونيًا لحارسين» over two rangers together: with a hiker (MP 18.91), at the stone wall (MP 32.23, focus 0.71 so both stay in), litter pickup in the meadow (MP 35.36), watching an elk (MP 36.69, focus 0.648): demonstration of co-op from the Multiplayer Trailer; the last 2 s are the meadow and the elk, a picture

sound: one stretch of the Multiplayer Trailer's own sound from 6.3 s (its only speech, 'Want to join me at work today?...', ends at 5.5 s on the seek timeline; faster-whisper small, no VAD, heard nothing after it); RMS -18 to -22 dB steady to 39 s, so the music runs past the end of the body; audio split puts each shot's own effects back
comparison: state 1 (one ranger, the Early Access park) against state 2 (the full release, two rangers), hard cuts (cut true); no figure on screen
credit: one entry 0 to 18 «المصدر: أستراغون إنترتينمنت (astragon)», the publisher's Arabic name in full and its Latin brand as its logo writes it

prerender full 15 Nov 05:02Z (run 43679078715): text ok, both sources decode clean, CLEAN; fixes after it: shot 10 replaced (cut-text 'Visitor Center'), elk shot ends at 37.79 (the trailer's '2-PLAYER CO-OP COMING NOVEMBER 17' sign starts 37.94), sunset shot ends at 13.19 (smear flag at 13.29 is the trailer's transition after the shot); OCR 'text' warns on shots 3, 4, 5, 12, 17 are 0.5 s windows outside the shots (before or after), checked on 9:16 crops

v2 after looking at the v1 Reel at 4 fps (cards/2026-11/rangers-path-full-release-nov-17-reel-v1.mp4, qc pass): the statue shot dropped (its two rangers cannot both fit 9:16, one was half cut at the edge); hikers focus 0.38 and meadow focus 0.42 keep two trail signboards out of the right edge; the bridge shot starts 0.2 s later, after a hiker leaving the left edge; hiker, wall and litter shots lengthened to their cuts. Timing matched the session's seek timebase in v1 (shots landed where planned)

v3 (director FAIL on v2): headline names the game, «لعبة Ranger's Path / تصدر كاملة الثلاثاء» (v2's «لعبة حارس الغابة» was an invented title); template relabelled trailer (reel.py has no state-label plate for comparison: cut=True only joins shots with hard cuts and labels states by lines, so the v2 Reel was not a true comparison); bison shot dropped (a ranger's shoulder at the edge in every crop), waterfall held to 2.55 s; hikers cut at 1.2 s before the blue-vest hiker leaves the left edge, sequoia 2.3 s; litter shot focus 0.56 keeps the half-cut partner out; credit 44 px (was 40); elk shot focus 0.625 so the elk is not cut at the left edge on its first frames

reel_check.1 primary read in full: yes: Steam announcements of 17 Sep ('Ranger's Path launches into Full Release on November 17!'), 8 Oct (co-op), 21 Oct ('On November 17, Ranger's Path will leave Early Access with its Full Release on PC and arrive on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S') and 28 Oct (Bigfoot teaser), read in full through the Steam news API 15 Nov 04:45Z; Steam appdetails: release 10 Mar 2026 (Early Access), publisher astragon Entertainment, developer To-Go Games, 53 AED
reel_check.1 not already posted: yes: git grep 'ranger', 'astragon', 'faremont' over newsroom/stories: no story about this game (ledger.py find crashes on a list folder, as noted on Stampede)
reel_check.1 older than 24h: dated launch: first announced 17 Sep; the news is the launch on Tuesday 17 Nov, two days after the slot (the same kind as Unicorn Academy 17 Nov and Spirit Crossing 16 Nov built today); no Arabic outlet has carried it
reel_check.3 story type items: yes: story_type_items (platforms, AED price in the caption, what it is)
reel_check.4 one spoken paragraph: yes: spoken, cut into the five lines in order
reel_check.4 subject named before pronoun, no line: yes: line 1 names the game; line 4 opens on «وتصل» and continues line 3 (النسخة الكاملة) at once
reel_check.4 release verbs: yes: تصدر for the date, تصل إلى + platforms
reel_check.4 names match names-ar: yes: أستراغون إنترتينمنت (astragon Entertainment) and تو-غو غيمز (To-Go Games) added as Proposed
reel_check.5 headline: yes: «لعبة Ranger's Path تصدر كاملة الثلاثاء», names the game first (24 Oct hook rule), opens on an Arabic word; DeepL back-check: 'Ranger's Path Will Be Released in Full on Tuesday'
reel_check.5 caption: yes: first five words «تصدر Ranger's Path كاملة يوم الثلاثاء» carry the game and the news word
reel_check.5 X and Threads: yes: one sentence, source «حسب إعلان أستراغون إنترتينمنت (astragon Entertainment) على Steam», no hashtags
reel_check.5 urgency: yes: chip رسمي (the publisher's own Steam announcements state the date and platforms)
reel_check.6 sound: yes: the Multiplayer Trailer's own sound, one stretch from 6.3 s, audio split
reel_check.6 no narration under lines: yes: whisper hears speech only at 1.2 to 5.5 s (seek timeline), before the stretch
reel_check.7 footage first: yes: two official Steam trailers, 1920x1080, 9:16 crop enlarged 1.78x
reel_check.7 not the same picture as last 5 Reels: yes: picture: rangers in a green national park; none of the last five (LoL, Minecraft, Stampede, Warhammer Survivors, Unicorn Academy)
reel_check.7 crop: yes: focus per shot from 9:16 crops of the first, middle and last frame
reel_check.7 headline not over a face: yes: the cover is a ranger's silhouette from behind at sunset; the headline sits in the sky
reel_check.7 credit on every clip: yes: one credit 0 to 18 with from_start
